newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps cuts Maderas y Sinteticos.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps cuts Maderas y Sinteticos.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it lowered its senior unsecured foreign currency rating of Maderas y Sinteticos SA (Masisa) to Triple B Minus from Triple B.
This action applies to the guaranteed senior notes of Masisa Overseas Ltd. Masisa is a Chilean-based wood panel manufacturer with operations in both Chile and Argentina.

Duff & Phelps said Masisa's operating performance has been dampened by increased competition in its core Chilean particle board business, a greater proportion of lower-margin exports in the sales mix and the weak Argentine economy.
